title: Insolvency, Restructuring and Dissolution Act 2018 (Act 40 of 2018); section 517 amends the Telecommunications Act
kind: the text of the Act or notification, from the e-Gazette copy
header_as_printed: REPUBLIC OF SINGAPORE / GOVERNMENT GAZETTE / ACTS SUPPLEMENT / Insolvency, Restructuring and / Published by Authority / Dissolution Bill / NO. 38] FRIDAY, NOVEMBER 9 [2018 / Bill No. 32/2018. / First published in the Government Gazette, Electronic Edition, on 7 November 2018 at 5 pm. / Read the first time on 10 September 2018. / The following Act was passed by Parliament on 1 October 2018 and assented / to by the President on 31 October 2018:— / INSOLVENCY, RESTRUCTURING AND / DISSOLUTION ACT 2018
first_published_line_as_printed: First published in the Government Gazette, Electronic Edition, on 7 November 2018 at 5 pm.
source_provider: Republic of Singapore Government Gazette, e-Gazette (www.egazette.gov.sg); the PDF is served as a static file from assets.egazette.gov.sg
obtained_how: One GET request (python urllib, scratchpad tools/gazette-fetch5.py), User-Agent "legalese-commons-source-fetcher/1.0 (+https://github.com/legalese/commons)", five seconds after the previous request, into a new download directory outside the repository, at the exact URL the team lead gave from the e-Gazette browse page. The assets host answered 200 with Content-Type application/pdf. No search path was used. The text is the output of "pdftotext -layout" on a PDF with a text layer (no OCR), unedited.
terms: e-Gazette Terms of Use, https://www.egazette.gov.sg/terms-of-use/, clause 11 "Reproduction of legislation-Gazettes"; the wording is quoted in the licence note.
evidence_status: The e-Gazette FAQ (https://www.egazette.gov.sg/faq/, read 2026-11-03) says: "Before 9 March 2025, only copies of the Gazette printed by the Government Printer are regarded as prima facie evidence of their contents."
